real.band: 58 cm round the band (55-60 by the strap), a 3 cm cotton sweatband
real.front: two foam panels 12 cm high from band to the top seam, stiff, standing about 1.5 cm off the forehead
real.mesh: polyester knit, 3.5 mm holes at 4.5 mm, four panels
real.bill: 7 cm from the forehead, pre-curved, 3-4 mm board, five rows of stitching 5 mm apart, rolled edge
real.rope: 4 mm braided cord across the front, its ends sewn under the crown at the corners of the bill
real.button: 1.6 cm, covered in the front cloth
real.opening: 6.5 cm wide, 4 cm high, bound in tape
real.strap: two plastic straps 1.8 cm high, seven studs
real.embroidery: the J 5 cm high in raised (3D, foam-backed) embroidery, a 1 mm satin outline, the seal ring 9 cm across
real.label: a woven label 3.5 x 2 cm over the back seam

wear.about: How World fits this cap to a head (src/avatars/hat-assets.js): a point's place on the head it was built on (head: its centre and radii, metres) is carried to the same place on the wearer's head; the hair under the crown is pressed in to `tuck` (head radii) above the band, except in the opening above the strap. `tint`: which recipe colour each material takes (its vertex colour a shade of it); `seeThrough`: the materials drawn as the hat's see-through layer, with `weave`.

head.recipe: the default adult (src/avatars/recipe.js DEFAULT_RECIPE): Rh 0.240555, width 0.94, height 1.08, oval
